mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_attribute WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND product_id=#{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product_attribute WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY attr_name ASC,id ASC

SELECT a.id,a.merchant_id,a.product_id,a.attr_name,a.attr_value,a.searchable,a.created_at,a.updated_at FROM product_attribute a JOIN product p ON p.merchant_id=a.merchant_id AND p.id=a.product_id WHERE a.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND a.product_id=#{productId} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY a.attr_name ASC,a.id ASC
